header.title: Day Trips & Excursions
header.subtitle: Discover the cultural, historical, and natural highlights surrounding Val Gardena with experienced local drivers and an itinerary shaped around your day.

dolomites-road.title: Great Dolomites Road & Passo Sella Loop
dolomites-road.desc: A full-day loop over Passo Sella, Gardena, Pordoi and Campolongo, with stops agreed with your driver.
dolomites-road.alt: Great Dolomites Road curving beneath the Sella Massif

alpine-hut.title: Romantic Alpine Hut Dinners & Night Shuttles
alpine-hut.desc: Evening transport to a mountain hut, with a return ride to your accommodation.
alpine-hut.alt: Traditional Dolomites mountain hut glowing warmly at blue hour

venice.title: Venice Lagoon & Grand Canal
venice.desc: A full-day return journey to Venice, with drop-off and pickup arranged near the historic centre.
venice.alt: Venice lagoon and historic waterfront viewed from the water

verona-garda.title: Verona Arena & Lake Garda Sirmione
verona-garda.desc: A day trip combining central Verona with Sirmione on Lake Garda.
verona-garda.alt: Sirmione peninsula extending into Lake Garda

innsbruck.title: Innsbruck Imperial & Swarovski Crystal Worlds
innsbruck.desc: A return trip over the Brenner Pass to central Innsbruck and Swarovski Crystal Worlds in Wattens.
innsbruck.alt: Innsbruck Golden Roof framed by the Nordkette mountains

bolzano-merano.title: Bolzano Ötzi Museum & Merano Thermal Spa
bolzano-merano.desc: Visit the Ötzi museum in Bolzano, then continue to Merano for its promenade and gardens.
bolzano-merano.alt: Merano riverside promenade with Mediterranean gardens and Alpine peaks
